mapper.select: SELECT b.block_id AS blockId, b.type AS blockType, s.step_id AS stepId, s.project_id AS projectId, b.created_by AS createdBy FROM block b JOIN step s ON s.step_id = b.step_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE b.block_id = #{blockId} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT 1 FROM block b JOIN step s ON s.step_id = b.step_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN project p ON p.project_id = s.project_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE b.block_id = #{blockId} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT pm.permission AS projectPermission, sp.permission AS stepPermission FROM block b JOIN step s ON s.step_id = b.step_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN project_member pm ON pm.project_id = s.project_id AND pm.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN step_permission sp ON sp.step_id = s.step_id AND sp.user_id = #{userId} WHERE b.block_id = #{blockId} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL
